faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about Rayhana products
faq.a1: Absolutely. Our Greblon C3+ ceramic coating is German-engineered, SGS certified, and 100% free from PFOA, PFAS, lead, and cadmium. It's designed for healthy cooking.
faq.a2: While our coating is durable, we recommend using silicone or wooden utensils (like the free ladle included) to extend the life of your pot.
faq.a3: Yes, Rayhana pots are dishwasher safe. However, hand washing with a soft sponge is recommended to maintain the non-stick performance for years.
faq.q4: Does it work on induction cooktops?
faq.a4: Yes! Our pots feature a premium induction bottom that works perfectly on gas, electric, ceramic, and induction stoves.

about_page.title: Our Journey
about_page.subtitle: From a longing for home to a global brand.
about_page.story_content: Rayhana is not just a kitchenware brand; it is a bridge between the past and the future. We were born from the deep longing of immigrants for the authentic tastes of home. In a world rapidly moving towards modernity, we are committed to keeping the aroma and flavor of traditional dishes alive in modern kitchens. Every Rayhana product is designed with love and precision to be not just a cooking tool, but a companion for creating sweet memories of family gatherings.
about_page.mission_content: Our mission is to bring the warmth and intimacy of traditional tables back to modern homes. We want to enable every Afghan and Persian-speaking immigrant to experience the true taste of home, wherever they are in the world, by offering world-class quality products with authentic design. We are committed to passing on a part of our rich culture and identity to future generations with every Rayhana pot.
about_page.founder_content: I have lived in China for over fifteen years and witnessed a challenge that thousands of Afghan and Persian-speaking immigrants faced: the lack of quality kitchenware for cooking traditional dishes. After years of extensive research and market analysis, I gained a deep understanding of this need. That moment was a turning point: I decided not only to identify the problem but to create a comprehensive solution with world-class quality. Thus, Rayhana was born a brand that understands the longing of immigrants and transforms it into reality.

world_cup_terms.title: World Cup Prediction Terms
world_cup_terms.subtitle: Please read these terms before submitting your Rayhana World Cup 2026 prediction.
world_cup_terms.summary: One valid prediction is accepted per email. Winners are selected according to campaign rules, availability, and Rayhana verification.

sections.title: Eligibility
sections.body: The campaign is open to participants who submit accurate contact information and are legally able to receive prizes in their country of residence. Rayhana may reject incomplete, duplicate, abusive, or suspicious entries.

sections.title: How to Enter
sections.body: Participants must submit their full name, email address, country of residence, the predicted 90-minute scores for both semi-finals, and the teams they believe will advance. Participants must accept these terms before submitting.

sections.title: One Entry per Email
sections.body: Only one semi-final prediction may be submitted per email address. If multiple entries appear to belong to the same participant, Rayhana may keep only the earliest valid entry or disqualify all related entries.

sections.title: Campaign Deadline
sections.body: Semi-final predictions must be submitted before July 15, 2026 at 18:55 GMT. Rayhana systems determine the final submission time. Late submissions will not be accepted.

sections.title: Final Prediction Stage
sections.body: Participants who successfully submit a semi-final prediction receive a reference code. After finalists are confirmed, eligible participants may use the same email and reference code to submit a final match prediction while the final stage is open.

sections.title: Prizes
sections.body: The planned prizes are one Rayhana Qabili pot size 12 for first place, one size 9 pot for second place, one size 7 pot for third place, and 23 discount codes of 26% for eligible Shopino24 Afghanistan or Amazon markets. Prize details may be adjusted if availability, shipping, legal, or platform restrictions require it.

sections.title: Discount Codes
sections.body: Discount codes are one-time use, have no cash value, cannot be sold or transferred, and apply only to the market specified in the winner email. Shipping, tax, customs, restricted items, gift cards, and non-eligible products are not covered unless explicitly stated.

sections.title: Winner Selection and Verification
sections.body: Rayhana may determine winners based on correct predictions, published campaign criteria, or a documented draw among eligible participants. Winners may be required to verify their identity, email, country, and delivery eligibility before a prize is issued.

sections.title: Public Winner Display
sections.body: If winner results are published, Rayhana may show partially masked names, country, prize position, and draw information for transparency while protecting participant privacy.

sections.title: No Affiliation
sections.body: This campaign is organized by Rayhana and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, sponsored by, or administered by FIFA, the World Cup, Amazon, or Shopino24 unless explicitly stated in a separate written agreement.

sections.title: Changes and Cancellation
sections.body: Rayhana may update campaign details, pause submissions, correct errors, cancel fraudulent entries, or cancel the campaign if technical, legal, supply, or operational issues make continuation impractical.

sections.title: Contact
sections.body: Questions about the campaign can be sent through the Rayhana contact page or to the official Rayhana support email listed on the website.
